name: Moss
anchor_space: pixels relative to foot_pivot, screen orientation (x right, y down)
source: castwork out/moss (procedural rig), imported by game/tools/import_cast.py
facing_rule: pick the facing whose vector is nearest the aim (while acting or standing) or the movement (while walking), with 10 degrees of hysteresis; keep the drawing index on a facing change; a weapon clip also picks its aim within the facing (aim_rule)

idle_fidgets.rule: after idle has shown for `after` s, play one fidget (random, never the same twice running) when idle reaches drawing 0, then idle; the next after a random `every` s of idle; any other clip cancels it at once (fidgets start and end on idle 0)

turn_inbetweens.rule: turn in-betweens, not playable facings: when the body facing changes between S N E W during a clip listed here, show turns[D] (the three-quarter drawing between the two facings) for `hold` s, keeping the drawing index and the clip time; a 180-degree turn passes through one side (D1, the cardinal between, D2; `hold_180` s each), the side the input rotates toward (S side on an exact reversal). A weapon clip shows its straight-ahead drawing on the in-betweens. Within a facing the weapon aim steps one aim_tag per `aim_step` s toward a new aim instead of jumping.
